line: Modest pay for safe work. I prefer higher margins, Shiny, but I’ll take what’s earned without complaint.
Nobody bled. The fee was insulting. We do these when we’re bored, not for profit.
Low risk. Small payout. That is the problem. I need work where the numbers match the boredom.
Safe is safe; the rate is insulting. I am not apologizing for charging what it costs to keep you alive against these peanuts.
Clean delivery. Low fee. I’m glad you’re safe, but next time, pick jobs that pay more.
Safe. Profitable? Barely. I’m keeping the ledger open only for jobs that bleed more than they pay.
The payout was meager. I have noted the discrepancy. Next time, let us ensure our labor matches the remuneration.
It closed quiet. That’s good. The fee landed on the low end, which is poor accounting. We stick to higher margins, Shiny.
Clean run, standard pay. I prefer the clarity of nothing going wrong to the risk of everything going right.
Safety is cheap labor. I do not bank on zero risks. Let us find work that costs more than it hurts.
